exposure.additional_exposure: All earlier empirical, source-case, development and reconstruction outcomes may have informed the fixed implementations. Do not label remaining dates an untouched confirmatory holdout. New full-population outcomes have not been read at this freeze.
exposure.purpose: full-population descriptive measurement, no untouched holdout claim

outcomes.anchor: Existing decision_at and geometry.entry when defined; otherwise the declared measurement-only reference. Only strictly subsequent native timestamps contribute; same-timestamp executions are excluded because order is unresolved.
outcomes.coverage: missing future interval explicitly unresolved; observed excursion extrema are lower bounds under gaps, never complete-horizon values
outcomes.execution: no simulated returns or actual fills; no new entry/exit/cost model
outcomes.expiry: Published outbound 09:40 ET deadline where applicable; otherwise existing 60-minute measurement horizon is measurement expiry, not invented source exit
outcomes.fixed_horizon_cap: 16:00 ET study-session endpoint; retain requested horizon and actual observed endpoint separately; truncation is not a complete fixed horizon
outcomes.missing_geometry: If geometry.entry is undefined, use the existing trigger C only if known at decision; otherwise the first strictly subsequent native timestamp-batch execution VWAP as a labeled measurement-only price origin, and record its later start. This never asserts an entry or adds a setup rule. Undefined stop/target remain undefined; excursions are independent of those missing boundaries.
outcomes.ordering: whole native timestamp batches; both boundaries in first crossing batch means unresolved ordering; earlier coverage gap means population first boundary unknown
outcomes.price_units: NQ points and ticks (0.25); favorable/adverse nonnegative maximum signed distance from fixed entry; no return or fill claim
outcomes.published_rules: Preserve existing observe_outcome: A2-OUTCOME 60 minutes, session end cap and Judas outbound 09:40 ET cap; retain original boundary result alongside added descriptive metrics

population.denominators: one unique coverage_id/session per search; full input eligible, partial/unavailable, scheduled closure, and personal/process scope are separately counted; partial observed setups never imply a complete-session denominator
population.duplicates: preserve distinct physical executions; unique coverage_id/candidate_id opportunities; cross-branch same-event instances retained as distinct definitions and never pooled as independent trades
population.end_rule: all acquired sessions through actual owned input endpoint; required earlier lookbacks are inputs only
population.selection: all calendar weekdays including holidays and partial endpoint sessions for explicit dispositions; no outcome-dependent exclusions, replacements or sampling

scope: existing reconstructed entry setups; source-intrinsic context retained; context, process, supplemental observations and personal execution units remain separate; no Phase 2 selector or parameter tuning

auction.inventory: displayed depth-one additions/removals; removal less executions is an estimate, not identified cancels
auction.response: difference of first/last quarter-window execution VWAP; efficiency divided by window range

calendar.interpretation: reconstruction calendar assumption, not newly recovered CME schedule evidence
calendar.model: regular NQ schedule with inferred New Year/Christmas RTH closures
calendar.scope: fixed-date New Year/Christmas closures, including Monday observance; Friday before Saturday New Year remains regular, corroborated by 390 native 2021-12-31 RTH minute records; other unverified holidays remain unavailable

strategy_policy.exposure: prior v2 engineering outcomes have been inspected; no holdout or profitability claim

gamma.KG1: largest absolute signed gamma strike; same-time NQ/QQQ mapping; inferred key-gamma node, not proprietary KG1
gamma.expiry: 0DTE if quoted; otherwise nearest listed expiry explicitly identified as a front-expiry approximation
gamma.inventory_assumption: call OI positive, put OI negative; model sign convention, not observed dealer inventory
gamma.option_model: European Black-Scholes, r=q=0, midquote implied volatility, 100 shares/contract
gamma.quote_availability: minute label plus 60 seconds; completed QQQ and NQ minute prices only

macro.model: equal mean of signed initial-release z scores: payroll positive, CPI negative; 12 prior initial observations
macro.output: research context only; not proprietary C-score or an entry

measurements.absence: all canonical records in an owned active-contract interval are enumerated; no execution does not imply missing data; market feed completeness remains separate
measurements.candle_endpoints: same-contract published OHLCV after interval close; fill only after native H/L/V and all already-known endpoints match
measurements.flow_entry_price: adverse-side observed price in the last execution timestamp batch; tick-valid research entry, not an actual fill
measurements.local_flow_price: execution VWAP of first and last timestamp batches; causal, order independent, not an inferred exchange sequence
measurements.prior_range: fallback to all acquired published prior RTH continuous-chart bars; contract changes remain explicit and unadjusted; empty post-expiration c.0 mapping windows excluded with recorded expiry and roll-map identity; never substituted for native volume profile or depth

strategy_policy.purpose: recreate strategy conditions from sources, excluding personal execution records

pzone.clock: historical minute-bar training only, prior dates; live anchor uses event-time bars
pzone.distance: maximum up/down move from anchor to 16:00 divided by pre-anchor 60-minute range
pzone.live_scale: current completed pre-anchor 60-minute range; quarter-point outward rounding
pzone.target: frozen anchor price; support and resistance evaluated only toward anchor
pzone.volume_filter: historical session volume at least median of prior training sessions

supersedes.reason: Pre-execution transcription correction: current A2-OUTCOME setting is 60 minutes. Add explicit measurement-only price origin for setup observations without an entry.

verification.charts: deterministic earliest candidate by branch and outcome category, ties candidate_id; include zero-setup/limitation examples per missing branch; visually inspect every selected chart
verification.checkpoints: immutable run/code/protocol/input hashes; resumable bounded date jobs; compare exact checkpoint hashes on repeat
verification.frozen_setup_rules: do not change baseline setup rules for result improvement; unavoidable correctness repairs require documented separate identity and preservation
verification.reports: branch/year/session-class frequency and denominators; native evidence, source and assumption versions, trigger/confirmation, geometry, outcomes and exclusions
